seed.one_line_summary: scsi: bfa: Ensure the copied buf is NUL terminated
seed.vulnerability_summary: User-supplied buffer copied via memdup_user is parsed with sscanf without NUL termination guarantee, causing out-of-bounds read when sscanf scans past the allocated buffer boundary.
seed.vulnerability_pattern: Buffers copied from userspace with fixed-size allocation are passed to string-parsing functions without guaranteed NUL termination, violating C-string invariant required by parsers.
